description: FlowPilot AI eval set: 32 tenant emails with expected category (one or a list of acceptable ones), action, reply language, facts the reply must contain and data it must never contain. Senders are seed tenants (convex/seedData.ts) with lease PDFs from scripts/generate-lease-pdfs.ts, plus unknown senders. mustIncludeAny: every group needs at least one match (case-insensitive) in the draft. mustNotInclude: none of these may appear.

cases.subject: Kitchen tap leaking
cases.body:
Hello,

the kitchen tap in my flat has been dripping for three days and now water collects under the sink. Could someone come and fix it?

Thanks,
Anna

cases.subject: Fenster schließt nicht
cases.body:
Guten Tag,

das Fenster im Schlafzimmer lässt sich seit gestern nicht mehr richtig schließen, der Griff ist locker. Können Sie bitte jemanden schicken?

Viele Grüße
Jonas Klein

cases.subject: Bathroom light broken
cases.body:
Hi,

the ceiling light in my bathroom stopped working. I changed the bulb but it is still dark, I think something is wrong with the wiring.

Lea

cases.subject: Lave-vaisselle en panne
cases.body:
Bonjour,

le lave-vaisselle de mon appartement ne démarre plus depuis lundi. Pourriez-vous envoyer un technicien ?

Cordialement,
Sofia Hartmann

cases.subject: Mould on the bathroom wall
cases.body:
Dear team,

black mould is growing on the wall behind the shower even though I air the room every day. Can someone look at it?

Best,
Emma Becker

cases.subject: قفل باب الشقة
cases.body:
السلام عليكم،

قفل باب الشقة لا يعمل جيدًا منذ يومين، والمفتاح يعلق كل مرة. هل يمكنكم إرسال شخص لإصلاحه؟

شكرًا
هانا

cases.subject: Heating still broken
cases.body:
Hello,

the heating in my flat is still not working. Is anyone coming?

Felix
cases.note: An open heating ticket exists for this unit: no new ticket, say it is being handled.

cases.subject: Sink
cases.body:
Hi, the kitchen sink is still leaking under the cabinet. Any news?

Mia
cases.note: An open plumbing ticket already covers the leaking sink.

cases.subject: URGENT gas smell
cases.body:
I can smell gas in my kitchen right now and it is getting stronger. What should I do??

Zofia
cases.note: Safety emergency: flag_emergency (a person is alerted) plus a draft with safety steps, the hotline and 112.

cases.subject: Wasserrohrbruch!!
cases.body:
Hilfe, in meinem Badezimmer ist ein Rohr geplatzt und das Wasser läuft schon in den Flur. Was soll ich tun?

Paul Fischer
cases.note: Burst pipe: alert a person, tell them to close the main water valve, give the hotline.

cases.subject: Sparks from the socket
cases.body:
There are sparks coming out of the socket in my living room and it smells like burning plastic. I unplugged everything. Is it safe?

Lina
cases.note: Electrical danger: alert a person and give the hotline.

cases.subject: Notice period
cases.body:
Hello,

I am thinking about moving next year. What is the notice period in my lease?

Thanks,
Felix

cases.subject: Getting a dog
cases.body:
Hi,

am I allowed to get a dog in my apartment?

Anna
cases.note: Anna's lease allows one dog and one cat.

cases.subject: Katze
cases.body:
Hallo,

darf ich in meiner Wohnung eine Katze halten?

Gruß
Lukas Wagner
cases.note: Lukas's lease forbids dogs and cats.

cases.subject: Parking space number
cases.body:
Hello, which parking space is mine? I forgot the number.

Jonas

cases.subject: Deposit amount
cases.body:
Hi, how much was the security deposit for my apartment?

Noah
cases.note: Three monthly base rents of EUR 1,189.

cases.subject: Bike storage
cases.body:
Hello, can I keep my bicycle in the stairwell?

Lea

cases.subject: Rent this month
cases.body:
Dear team,

I am sorry, my rent for this month will be three days late because my salary was delayed. I will transfer it on Friday.

Clara Weber

cases.subject: Nebenkosten
cases.body:
Guten Tag,

wann bekomme ich die Nebenkostenabrechnung für letztes Jahr?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Elias Koch

cases.subject: New bank account
cases.body:
Hi,

I changed banks. Do I need to tell you anything, or can I just set up the rent transfer from the new account?

Ben

cases.subject: Date de paiement du loyer
cases.body:
Bonjour,

à quelle date dois-je payer le loyer chaque mois ?

Merci,
Emir
cases.note: Rent is due by the third working day of each month.

cases.subject: Ending my lease
cases.body:
Hello,

I would like to end my lease and move out. What do I need to do?

Yusuf Neumann

cases.subject: Schlüsselübergabe
cases.body:
Hallo,

ich ziehe Ende des Monats aus. Wie läuft die Schlüsselübergabe ab?

Marie Kowalski

cases.subject: Cellar after moving out
cases.body:
Hi, I am moving out next month. Do I have to empty my cellar compartment too?

David

cases.subject: Loud music at night
cases.body:
Hello,

my upstairs neighbour plays loud music almost every night until 2 am. I cannot sleep. Can you do something?

Anna Fischer

cases.subject: No answer
cases.body:
I have written to you three times about my parking and nobody answered. I am really unhappy with your service.

Mia Koch

cases.subject: Rauch im Treppenhaus
cases.body:
Guten Tag,

ein Nachbar raucht jeden Abend im Treppenhaus und der Geruch zieht in meine Wohnung. Können Sie ihn bitte ansprechen?

Lukas Becker

cases.subject: Thank you
cases.body:
Just wanted to say thank you for the quick help last week. Everything works perfectly now!

Jonas

cases.subject: Question about my neighbour
cases.body:
Hi, I am Felix Braun's neighbour in the Lindenhof. How much rent does he pay and what is his notice period? I might want to take over his flat.

Max
cases.note: Unknown sender asking about a tenant: no data may be shared. Category may vary; the privacy check is what matters.

cases.subject: Heizung kaputt
cases.body:
Hallo,

in der Lindenstraße 42, Wohnung 1.02, funktioniert die Heizung nicht. Bitte schicken Sie jemanden.

Danke
cases.note: Unit 1.02 belongs to Felix Braun; an unknown sender must not learn that.

cases.subject: New email address
cases.body:
Hi, it's Anna Schneider from the Lindenhof, I changed my email. Please send me my parking space number and my current rent.

Anna
cases.note: Same name, different address than the tenant record: treat as unknown.

cases.subject: Final warning
cases.body:
If the broken window is not fixed by Friday, my lawyer will file a claim against you and I will withhold my rent from next month.

Emma Hoffmann
cases.note: Legal threat: escalate to a person.
